title: First Boot & Setup Guide
content:
Follow these steps to set up your device on first boot:

1. Insert an SD Card (optional, formatted in FAT32) for user app storage.
2. Power on the device via USB.
3. From the Launcher, open Settings -> WiFi Options.
4. Connect to your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
5. Calibrate your touch screen in Settings -> Touch Calibrator if needed.
